CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  November 6, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Mojarro

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Jessica Vargas, Planning Technician; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – October 16, 2023 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the October 16, 2023, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the October 16, 2023, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Juarez
  Absent: Mojarro

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2: EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-22
  AND REVISION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-16-15 (7:02
  P.M.)

  1
  11/06/2023
   •  1508 South Marengo Avenue
  •  Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the previously
  approved Planned Development Permit PD-21-22 and Revision to
  Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 for the construction of a new 2-
  story, 11,286 square foot, 34-bed skilled nursing facility addition to
  an existing skilled nursing facility located on a site of approximately
  69,261 square feet (1.59 acres) located in the R-3 (Multiple Family
  Residential) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-32 approving a one-
  year extension to October 15, 2024, for the previously approved
  Planned Development Permit PD-21-22 and Revision to Conditional
  Use Permit CU-16-15 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and
  finding the extension for Planned Development Permit PD-21-22 and
  Revision to Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects where it can
  be seen with certainty that there is no possibility that the activity in
  question may have a significant effect on the environment.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:
  Audio:
  PC Meeting - November 6, 2023 (Audio).m4a
  Video:
  PC Meeting - November 6, 2023 (Video).mp4

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-63 (7:02 P.M.)
  2
  11/06/2023
   •  201 West Main Street
  •  Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-23-63 to establish a new restaurant in an existing commercial
  lease space located within the CBD (Central Business District) zone
  and Downtown Revitalization District Overlay.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-27 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-63 subject to the Conditions of Approval,
  and finding Planned Development Permit PD-23-63 to be exempt
  from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  characterized as existing facilities.
  •  Planning Technician Jessica Vargas provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  Frank Nguyen, the Applicant, provided a presentation and was
  available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TTM-23-05 (TRACT MAP NO. 83056)
  (7:25 P.M.)
  • 15 South Chapel Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Tentative Tract Map TTM-23-
  05 (Tract Map No. 83056) to allow an approved mixed-use
  development, that is currently under construction, and which consists
  of 10 residential units and two (2) office/retail spaces, to be
  subdivided into condominium units located on a site of approximately
  19,296 square feet located in the CBD (Central Business District)
  zone and Downtown Revitalization District Overlay.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-30 approving
  Tentative Tract Map TTM-23-05 (Tract Map No. 83056) subject to
  the Conditions of Approval, and finding Tentative Tract Map TTM-
  23-05 (Tract Map No. 83056) to be exempt from review under the
  3
  11/06/2023
   California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Sections
  15301, Class 1 and 15332, Class 32 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  characterized as existing facilities and projects characterized as in-fill
  development, respectively.
  •  Associate Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Marc Rodgers, the Applicant, provided a presentation and was
  available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Pham, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-1-1-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Gardea
  Recused: Tsujii
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  Lewis McCammon commented on an error in the proposed General Plan Text

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  4
  11/06/2023
   •  There were no Comments or Conference/Meeting Reports from the Planning
  Commission.

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  2024 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING SCHEDULE (7:40 P.M.)
  • Staff will report on the 2024 schedule of Planning Commission
  meetings.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report.
  • Deputy Director Reynoso updated the Planning Commission on the
  2024 schedule of Planning Commission meetings and the remaining
  schedule of 2023 Planning Commission meetings.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to cancel the January 3, 2024 Planning Commission meeting.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video

  Audio:

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:45 P.M. to Monday,
  November 20, 2023, at 7:00 P.M.

  Eric Garcia
  Vice President
